Duncan joins Front Office Sports to discuss becoming Netflix’s first sports anchor in the biggest Netflix year yet, featuring MLB Opening Day, the Home Run Derby, and Christmas Day NFL games. She explains what convinced her to leave ESPN for Netflix, how she prepared for Alex Honnold’s stunning free solo of Taipei 101, and what she’s watching on her own Netflix account.
